$comment: Repo-local Claude Code config, committed so it travels with the template. The TDD guard (tdd-guard) is OFF by default since 2026-10-14: every check it makes is a headless Claude call, which fails closed without API credit and then blocks every Claude edit. To opt in on your machine, add its PreToolUse hook to the gitignored .claude/settings.local.json; docs/TOOLING.md, 'TDD guard', has the snippet. CI (lint, test, build) is the real gate.
